generate_difference_report: generate a difference report comparing two benchmark JSON runs with optional U-test statistical analysis
filter_benchmark: filter benchmark JSON results by regex pattern and optionally replace matching names
calculate_change: calculate the decimal change between an old and new benchmark value
get_unique_benchmark_names: get all unique benchmark names from a JSON results object while preserving order
calc_utest: calculate Mann-Whitney U test p-values for CPU and real time benchmark comparisons
